description: Use this skill whenever code writes to a log or builds an error message for a user — a catch block, an exception handler, a logger call, telemetry, a debug line added while hunting a bug — and whenever the user says a log is noisy or useless, an error message shows SQL or a stack trace, a support ticket contains data it should not, or asks what is safe to log. It gives what must never reach a log or a screen, what to keep so the log stays diagnosable, and where the redaction goes in each stack, which is not the same place. Do not use it to choose a logging library or to configure log shipping, retention or dashboards.
